rationale: Price is at 96.9% of today's range and within 0.25% of the session high ($14.02), with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely compressed range and declining volume — classic exhaustion/consolidation at resistance rather than a clean breakout. A long entry here risks buying the top of a large prior-day surge with no news catalyst and no fresh momentum, while a short against a strong uptrend with tight spread and elevated relative volume carries equal risk of continuation through the high. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the ambiguous tape at this level.
